feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 November 2026 4:30pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 20 November 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

A ridge of high pressure extends across the Irish Sea area from eastern Greenland.


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, settling east or southeast 3 or 4 overnight, increasing 4 or 5 around midday tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight occasionally moderate tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Risk of mist in the southeast of the area overnight and at first tomorrow. Occasional rain or showers in the west tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow evening, then 6 or 7 overnight into Sunday. Decreasing 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough for a time during Sunday.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with a risk of mist in the southeast of the area tomorrow evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate.
